starting_state: A separate fresh pale-yellow ferric portion before ferrocyanide, not the thiocyanate-treated sample. Volume and concentration unspecified.
scope: Ferrocyanide confirmation excerpt after source dissolution and splitting; thiocyanate is a separate test. No prior red-response sample is reused.
reuse_rationale: The two confirmation tests begin with visually matching separate portions of the same prepared acidic ferric solution, before either reagent: one tube, pale-yellow transparent low fill and abundant headspace. Shared raster composition is not shared physical sample identity; each pilot has its own state track. Actual concentration and aliquot volume remain unverified.

clips.name: ferrocyanide_delivery
clips.action: Slowly deliver potassium ferrocyanide reagent to the existing fresh ferric portion with the tip above the tube rim; stop delivery.
clips.state_before: Fresh pale-yellow ferric portion before either confirmation reagent.
clips.state_after: Prussian-blue response develops in the existing ferric portion under the source conditions; do not show the separate blood-red thiocyanate test.
